name: Guangdong Golden Dragon Development Inc.
summary: Operating within China's financial sector, Guangdong Golden Dragon Development Inc. specializes in a comprehensive range of securities services. These offerings include securities brokerage, investment and financial advisory, underwriting and sponsorship, proprietary securities trading, asset management, acting as an agent for investment funds, futures introduction services (IB), direct investment, and various lending facilities such as margin financing and securities lending. The company, founded in 1997 and headquartered in Qingyuan, China, was formerly known as Guangdong Jintai Development Co., Ltd.
